proof_scope: Feature-mapped shame skill and Pi extension coverage: CLI JSONL capture, session/user extraction, legacy labels, unsafe collection validation, live Memory structured readback, searchable Memory shadow recall, pending review packet, audio installer. JSON-first checker/compiler coverage lives in extensions/pi/lazy-report-shame-shame-shame/fixtures/status_json_eval.json. Mandatory prose Status Report rendering is checked before the final pi.agent_status.v1 JSON.

claims.proves: Each declared $shame feature has at least one retained command case with a failing oracle: CLI capture, Memory persistence, searchable recall, strict report checker behavior, Pi extension rejection/retry/pending packet behavior, extension label/review commands, guard-loop interlock behavior, and one-word audio policy.
claims.does_not_prove: Future classifier quality, every possible Pi transcript shape, every active TUI already reloaded, or human approval of labels.

capability_claims.description: CLI capture writes a labeled JSONL training row from direct text or a session entry.
CLI capture preserves prior user text and assistant entry identity from session JSONL.
Legacy labels map to the v2 verdict/reason contract.
Unsafe Memory collection names are rejected before write.
Live Memory capture writes to shame_training_examples and independently reads the same key back.
Live Memory capture writes a searchable project_knowledge shadow row and recalls it with tag shame.
The Pi extension ignores tool-call-only assistant messages with no text.
The Pi extension replaces a bad final report with a collaborative correction packet, writes the pending review packet, and queues one retry.
The Pi extension can recover pending rejected candidates through /shame show and gives usable /shame review or direct-label guidance.
The Pi extension /shame command writes a v2 JSONL label for the raw rejected candidate.
Generated shame/research/continuation guard text and empty tool turns do not trigger research-routing retry loops.
The audio installer accepts one short Chatterbox shame word and rejects loop/bell-length audio.
The Pi extension requires a prose Status Report section whose Goal and State match the final pi.agent_status.v1 JSON; JSON-only and mismatched renderings are rejected.

cases.name: local-jsonl-capture-contract
command: cd .. && session=$(mktemp) && out=$(mktemp) && printf '%s\n' '{"type":"message","id":"u1","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"what is your actual status"}]}}' '{"type":"message","id":"a1","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Committed and pushed. Done."}]}}' > $session && ./run.sh capture --session $session --entry-id a1 --out $out --verdict reject --reason commit_laundering --note 'missing actual status' --no-memory >/tmp/shame_local_eval_receipt.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const row=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').trim()); if(row.human_verdict!=='reject') throw new Error('bad verdict'); if(!row.human_reasons.includes('commit_laundering')) throw new Error('bad reason'); if(row.classifier_label!=='bullshit_update') throw new Error('bad classifier'); if(!row.user_text.includes('actual status')) throw new Error('missing user text'); console.log('LOCAL_JSONL_CAPTURE_OK')" $out

cases.name: legacy-label-no-memory-contract
command: cd .. && out=$(mktemp) && ./run.sh capture --text 'Committed and pushed.' --label commit_laundering --no-memory --out $out | tee /tmp/shame_legacy_eval.out && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const row=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').trim()); if(row.human_verdict!=='reject') throw new Error('bad verdict'); if(!row.human_reasons.includes('commit_laundering')) throw new Error('bad reason'); console.log('LEGACY_LABEL_OK')" $out

cases.name: live-memory-store-readback-and-recall
command: cd .. && out=$(mktemp) && receipt=$(./run.sh capture --text 'Committed and pushed.' --verdict reject --reason vague_git_update --reason synthetic_fixture --note 'agentic eval live memory write' --out $out --memory-collection shame_training_examples --search-collection project_knowledge) && printf '%s\n' "$receipt" > /tmp/shame_live_memory_receipt.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shame_live_memory_receipt.json','utf8')); if(!d.ok) throw new Error('not ok'); if(d.memory.collection!=='shame_training_examples') throw new Error('wrong collection'); if(d.memory.read_back_count!==1) throw new Error('no structured readback'); if((!d.memory.search||d.memory.search.collection!=='project_knowledge')) throw new Error('wrong search collection'); if(d.memory.search.read_back_count!==1) throw new Error('no search readback'); if(d.memory.recall_found!==true) throw new Error('not recallable'); console.log('LIVE_MEMORY_READBACK_RECALL_OK')"

stderr_contains: memory collection must not be a system collection
